title: Intake & planning huddle
summary: A request lands, the lead calls a huddle on 4F, the team plans, claims scopes, votes on D-proposals, fills the board, works, regroups and asks you for a call.

events.log: X-Ray: packages/theme and src/ui are the blast radius

events.text: Scout: both platforms recommend following system appearance by default and remembering an override.
Logging risks: chip contrast (Grok), token churn touching about 40 files (Codex).
Churn is contained: I will alias the old token names. Diff stays under 300 lines.
Question: persist the choice per user or per device? Per user needs login sync.
Per device. Pitchside has guest browsing; most viewers never sign in.
Agree. And "system" as the default avoids a surprise on first launch.
Proposal D-14: store the theme per device, default to system. YES or NO. Two matching votes lock it.

item.text: Theme stored per device, default = system

events.text: [Lead · Claude Code] D-14 · Theme stored per device, default = system. Vote YES/NO in #decisions, two matching votes win.
NO from me: per user is nicer. I will live with it.
D-14 is locked: per device, default to system. Next, D-15.
